name: Grilled sea urchin
summary: Grilled sea urchin. The specialty-seafood account also calls it echinus: spikes off, halved and drained, then oil, roasted peanuts, and spring onion on the grill. You scoop it and dip it in lime and pepper sauce. The nature account serves echinus with grilled oysters, roasted shallots, peanuts, and green onion. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Phu Quoc. The specialty-seafood account, the whisper account, the day account, and the nature account all name sea urchin. They were not shown to be one plate.
texture: The specialty-seafood account calls the grilled urchin creamy once it is tender. It also says the urchin comes in various styles and prints this grill method.
taste: Zest, spice, and a fresh aroma on the specialty-seafood account, from the lime and pepper sauce. The nature account adds roasted shallots, peanuts, and green onion, and serves the urchin with grilled oysters.
howToEat: Take a spoon, scoop the urchin, and dip it in lime and pepper sauce. That is the specialty-seafood account. It says the best place is the Dinh Cau night market.

The day account calls frilled sea urchin a favourite and prints no method. The whisper account names nhum and prints no method. The nature account pairs echinus with grilled oysters. All four stay. An hour and a price are Check on arrival.
where: Dinh Cau night market, on the specialty-seafood account. The other accounts name the coast and no door. A street number is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Nhum bien — grilled sea urchin on Phu Quoc
seoDescription: Nhum biển is grilled with peanuts and spring onion, then dipped in lime and pepper. Another account serves it with oysters. A price is Check on arrival.
